description:
A limited artifact produced by postal failure rather than commercial demand. Only ten exist. None are for sale.

An Oops Sticker can enter circulation only when Kotiki-Nar themselves—or an authorised third-party courier acting on behalf of Nar-Mail Express—issue one as an apology for a genuine delivery incident. It cannot be ordered, reserved or purchased. Offering unlimited money does not improve your chances.

Its scarcity therefore operates backwards: the more competent the postal service becomes, the rarer the sticker becomes.

It is not compensation in any recognised financial sense. It is an admission. A very small one. Losing your own parcel deliberately does not qualify.
